description.zh: 定义 <trigger> 和 <effect> 的标准执行流程。
description.en: Defines the standard execution flow for <trigger> and <effect>.

description.zh: 评估 <trigger>.<condition>——对 <state> 的谓词，按边沿求值。假则终止。
description.en: Evaluate <trigger>.<condition> — an edge-evaluated predicate over <state>. Terminate if false.

description.zh: 足额支付 <trigger>.<cost>。无法足额支付则终止。为 null 时跳过。
description.en: Pay <trigger>.<cost> in full. Terminate if unable to pay in full. Skip if null.

description.zh: 确定作用目标。为 null 时跳过。
description.en: Determine the target object. Skip if null.

description.zh: <resolve> <trigger>.<content>——将内容应用到 <state>。按三种形态分别处理：<instant_content> 一次性执行、<continuous_content> 进入生效池电平维持、<effect> 按 instant/continuous 武装。
description.en: <resolve> <trigger>.<content> — applies content to <state>. Handled per form: <instant_content> executes once, <continuous_content> enters the active pool for level maintenance, <effect> arms as instant/continuous.
